question: What should one make in solitude while intent on meditation?
premises: One should make form in many ways.
One should be intent on meditation in solitude.
inference: In solitude, one should make form in many ways while intent on meditation.
uncertainties: Whether kuru governs both rūpaṃ and dhyānañ is ambiguous.
plain_english: In solitude, make form in many ways and be intent on meditation.
